reasoning: This UI state icon depicts 'stop screen sharing' (a laptop with a share arrow inside, crossed out by a slash), which also reads more broadly as 'no laptop / screen-free'. While mainly an in-call toggle, it fits specific troubleshooting tasks around broken screen sharing, disabling guest permissions, or taking a screen detox, though at list size the slashed arrow is cramped and easy to misread.
